patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution imagery dominates sections, often with minimal text overlaid directly on the image, creating an immersive experience.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy against clean, minimal body text, often in all caps for emphasis.
A stark, high-contrast palette of black, white, and dark grey is punctuated by a vibrant blue for primary calls to action and a distinct red/orange for promotional accents.
Sections are revealed with a smooth slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience, complemented by a subtle hero image parallax.
Product sections are presented as large, immersive image cards with overlaid product names and brief descriptions, often in a two-column grid.

technique_notes: The site uses scroll-triggered animations (css-keyframes) to reveal content; as the user scrolls, new sections smoothly slide up into view from the bottom, creating a sense of progression.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground elements, adding depth.
The main navigation bar becomes fixed to the top of the viewport after a short scroll, ensuring constant access without changing its visual style.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) with clear, legible body and descriptive text, maintaining a modern sans-serif character.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a tighter grid for product listings, creating a clean, open feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its highly immersive, full-bleed product photography that serves as the primary visual element, often with text directly overlaid. This, combined with subtle scroll-triggered reveals and a minimalist aesthetic, creates a premium, cinematic experience that prioritizes visual impact over dense information.
